assessments: Education Act Chap. 39:01 names no assessment instrument and uses the word speech zero times
It leaves the mode of determining a category and the examination of children to Regulations
PEER's policy statements promise diagnostic testing at primary level but name no test
dischargeCriteria: Education Act Chap. 39:01 sets no rule ending a child's special education
The Act's only ending power is the Minister disestablishing a special school, class or service
Discharge appears in the Act only at s.63, on a teacher discharging the duties of office
Education Act 2005 sets no exit or discharge rule for a special education programme
Its only termination clause, s.81, ends a home education programme, not special education
The entitlement at s.82(1) is bounded to students of compulsory school age
